scores.evidence: The s2-layers flowchart TD fits at 390 px with readable Japanese labels and a caption (mobile-jp-06/07). Both 2-column tables (s2-table, s5-table) wrap cleanly with nothing cut off (mobile-jp-07, mobile-jp-13/14), and the code blocks fit without sideways scrolling. On every desktop screen the glossary panel lists プロンプトインジェクション, ワークスペースの信頼 and サンドボックス twice each.

No text-only screens (metrics textOnlyScreens empty). Each section has a figure, table, code block or check close by. s5-md2 is the densest paragraph run: 3 facts in a row before the table (mobile-jp-13). The practice section has three one-step 'steps' blocks, each with its own '手順 1ステップ中 0 完了' header, which reads as repetitive (mobile-jp-16, mobile-jp-18).

The UI and all content are in Japanese with no stray English UI. The diagram has alt text, and the controls stay clear of the top and bottom bars. Line breaks inside Japanese words are rare (practice-steps-deny breaks '作/り、' before inline code on mobile-jp-16). The doubled glossary chips (with and without the English gloss) make the term list ambiguous for learners.

mustFix.issue: The desktop glossary panel ('用語・このレッスン') shows three terms twice: 'プロンプトインジェクション（prompt injection）' and 'プロンプトインジェクション', 'ワークスペースの信頼（workspace trust）' and 'ワークスペースの信頼', 'サンドボックス（sandbox）' and 'サンドボックス'. The definitions-block terms in s1-defs and s2-defs do not match the glossary entries.
mustFix.fix: Make each definitions `term` in s1-defs and s2-defs match its glossary `term` exactly. For example, use 'プロンプトインジェクション' as the term, put '(prompt injection)' at the start of the md or in the glossary entry's `aliases`, and do the same for ワークスペースの信頼 and サンドボックス, so the panel lists each concept once.

niceToHave: Merge practice-steps, practice-steps-deny and practice-steps-bill into a clearer sequence, or give each step a distinct title. Right now three separate '手順 1ステップ中 0 完了' headers, each numbered 1, appear in a row (mobile-jp-16, mobile-jp-18).
s5-md2: split the second paragraph or move the /clear vs /compact sentence next to the s5-table row so the run before the table is shorter (mobile-jp-13).
reader: the glossary panel shows 10 chips and leaves out the lesson's 8th glossary term エフォート (desktop-jp-09); it may be capped.
reader: desktop JP chars-per-line median is 44, above the 30–40 target (measure 680 px at 18.7 px).
reader: inline code wraps mid-token on mobile ('claude -' / 'p' in e5, '-' / 'p' in option 4, mobile-jp-24). This is known reader behaviour.
reader: the mobile full-length PNG is truncated at 16000 px, and the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json. Both are known.
summary: The screenshots show lesson hash sha256:31ca899dd855ae10, as expected. There are no hard failures (no overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors) and no personal data on any screen; the bottom-left 'JP' is the language toggle. The layout holds up well at 390 px: the TD flowchart, both 2-column tables and all code blocks are readable and nothing is cut off. The one must-fix is the duplicated glossary chips on desktop: make the definitions terms in s1-defs and s2-defs match the glossary entries so each term appears once.
